description: This file implements a driver for the Motorola MC146818 RTC chip within the Zephyr RTOS, including functions for reading, writing, setting, and getting RTC time, handling alarms, and managing interrupts.

methods.name: rtc_read
methods.description: Reads a byte from a specified RTC register.

methods.name: rtc_write
methods.description: Writes a byte to a specified RTC register.

methods.name: rtc_mc146818_validate_time
methods.description: Validates the provided RTC time structure.

methods.name: rtc_mc146818_alarm_set_callback
methods.description: Sets the callback for alarm events.

methods.name: rtc_mc146818_alarm_is_pending
methods.description: Checks if an alarm is pending.

methods.name: rtc_mc146818_update_set_callback
methods.description: Sets the callback for RTC update events.

methods.name: rtc_mc146818_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for RTC events.
